sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Onni, Henry take up arms and a day's rations (4,030 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.

⚔️ Onni killed the Ugly-Eyes with their party — 1 round, 10 taken. Word travels fast. Cornered at the treeline, it could not slip away before a blow. The carcass is out there — haul it home before it rots.

⚔️ Onni killed the Highbeam Deer with their party — 3 rounds, 39 taken. Word travels fast. Cornered at the treeline, it could not slip away before a blow. The carcass is out there — haul it home before it rots.
⚔️ The Influencer mauled Onni (-45 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Influencer gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
